mr_close_challenge: Close the challenge: show the tasks of all challenges
mr_zoom_in: Zoom in to see the tasks here (from zoom 12).
mr_no_next: No other open task in view.
mr_open_invalid: Enter a challenge number or a link to a challenge or task on MapRoulette.
mr_nearby_none: No open MapRoulette task in this view.
mr_login_none: Not logged in to MapRoulette: reading works, sending a status needs a token
mr_login_hint: MapRoulette is changing how editors log in. Until that is done, paste a personal token from your MapRoulette profile; it stays in this browser and is sent only to MapRoulette.
mr_waiting_title: {count} tasks wait for your next upload
mr_tag_fix_not_loaded: The feature of this suggestion is not loaded yet: zoom in to it.
mr_timing_with_save_hint: The status goes to MapRoulette after your changeset is uploaded, with a link to it.
mr_timing_right_away_hint: The status goes to MapRoulette now, with your comment.
mr_timing_tag_fix: A tag fix is reported with the upload, so the edit and the status go together.
mr_done_queued: {status}: goes to MapRoulette with your next upload
mr_resolve_done: MapRoulette knows of the {count} tasks of your upload.
mr_resolve_failed: {ok} tasks reported; {failed} were refused and wait for the next upload.
mr_save_hint: {count} tasks are reported to MapRoulette after the upload, with a link to the changeset.
mr_save_no_login: {count} tasks would be reported, but there is no MapRoulette token (the MapRoulette button): they stay waiting for the next upload.
mr_error_login: MapRoulette did not accept the login.
mr_error_timeout: MapRoulette did not answer in time.
